ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels; the fluke surface is approximately 97% low-intensity black with minimal localized high-intensity pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous black distribution across both lobes; high-intensity spatial mapping is limited to discrete point-clusters (circular spots) and thin linear vectors (scars) distributed semi-randomly, with a high-density contiguous cluster of textured pixels on the distal right lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with sharp interior convergence; notch depth is approximately 15% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; trailing boundary displays a continuous sequence of peaks and valleys with varying pixel-amplitudes, creating a distinctly jagged silhouette.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve trajectory fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, resulting in sharp, upward-sloping distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of high-intensity circular pixel groups localized at the terminal apex of the right lobe (barnacles); sparse constellation of individual white circular spots across the medial ventral regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) primarily located on the proximal-medial section of the left lobe and the central-lateral section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent high-contrast, textured biological mass (barnacles) on the right distal tip; extensive healed linear scarring across the central ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical morphology of distal tips: right tip exhibits a thickened, irregular textural profile due to barnacle accumulation, whereas the left tip maintains a smoother, more continuous geometric edge.
